ops.text: OUTAGE RECOVERY: a machine-wide DNS outage froze this orchestrator (every capt-hook PreToolUse call needs PyPI resolution — total tool lockout, Stop-hook loop) and killed BOTH P7 lane sessions mid-work. Recovery per the failed-idle-lanes memory protocol: worktree-churn + message probes confirmed both dead; successors spawned with adoption protocols. p7-flake-2 (opus): predecessor's 2 commits intact (4b63c41d atomic corpus build, 9a9c57d3 session-scoped order-independent provisioning — the #27 flake root cause was corpus provisioning order, NOT parity: the only builder was collected alphabetically after test_activity_parity, CI masked it by pre-building; deterministic fresh-worktree repro; rider #67 verified no-op, zero cargo warnings); successor adds the count-check hardening (SIGKILL-partial corpus), then holds for one adversarial codex pass before landing (the generator feeds every golden + bench). p7-docs-2 (fable): predecessor committed the [13.2.0] backfill (bd8c08b2 — the splice release had shipped to PyPI UNRECORDED) + the finalized v14 CHANGELOG entry (08571df6); dirty README + ownership-fragment edits adopted finish-or-restart; four orchestrator adjudications bind it (13.2.0 backfill=yes; curated reference public-API-only, SpecMatcher/keep_events/embedded_literals deliberately private for v14 w/ P8 note on captain-hook possibly resurfacing SpecMatcher; dead cli: block dropped; dev-guide fragment dead lines fixed). Main drifted during the outage — checked at recovery.
